root_cause.text: The `idxd_conf_device_release()` path in the DMAengine `idxd` driver freed the `struct idxd_device` resources without destroying the device’s associated workqueue, because the `.release()` callback omitted `destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq)`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq);` to `drivers/dma/idxd/sysfs.c` inside `idxd_conf_device_release()`, and the CVE/commit message explicitly says “The workqueue associated with an DSA/IAA device is not released when the object is freed.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Destroy the device workqueue during configuration device release to avoid resource leaks and unsafe cleanup ordering.
intent_record.what: A call to destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq) was inserted at the start of idxd_conf_device_release(), before freeing idxd->groups, idxd->wq_enable_map, and idxd->wqs.
intent_record.how: When the configuration device is released, its workqueue is now explicitly torn down first, ensuring any queued or running work is cleaned up before related device resources are freed and preventing leaks or use-after-free issues.
